This PKGBUILD is a standard binary package for Betterbird (a Thunderbird fork) with French localization. The `source` array fetches:
1. A tarball from `https://www.betterbird.eu/downloads/LinuxArchive/` (legitimate upstream)
2. Two local helper files (`.desktop` entry and vendor preferences)

The echo statement in `package()` is a thank-you message to AUR users, which is benign.

Running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will safely download and extract the sources without executing anything malicious.
</details>
<evidence>

Standard binary AUR package with verified upstream source and valid checksums.</summary>
